---
name: Feedback
description: Share feedback about Leviathan's public experience, design, documentation, direction, or usability
title: "[Feedback] "
labels: []

---

## What are you giving feedback on?

Name the Leviathan area, page, flow, visual, documentation section, or public feature.

## What works well?

Tell us what should be kept or expanded.

## What could be improved?

Describe what feels confusing, missing, slow, difficult, inconsistent, or unnecessary.

## What would you change?

Explain your preferred experience or outcome.

## Screenshots or examples

Add public screenshots, mockups, or reference links if helpful. Do not include credentials, tokens, private endpoints, personal data, or other sensitive information.

## Additional context

Anything else that would help us understand the feedback.
